direction.sound: Record the isolated phoneme only, not the letter name and not the keyword (the keyword shows which sound is meant). Continuous sounds (a e i o u m n s z) held about 0.6 s; stop sounds (b c d g p t) short and unvoiced where English is, with no added vowel ("p", not "puh"). One take each; every take auditioned by ear before it ships: a TTS phoneme that adds a vowel teaches the wrong sound.
direction.word: The word alone, naturally, warm and clear, with a short pause before it.
direction.line: Warm, clear storybook guide for a 5-year-old, unhurried. Match the existing kingdom narration.
direction.reaction: Same as lines, with a little delight.

pack.approval: Owner instruction (2026-10-12): generate the 5 target words and 12 required lines with the approved project voice (D163 terms, as elevenlabs-narration-v1). Letter sounds excluded until auditioned.
pack.processing: Each take level-matched with a fixed gain (gainDb, no compression) to -26 LUFS integrated, true peak at most -1.5 dBTP, re-encoded mp3 128 kbps mono 44.1 kHz (ffmpeg ebur128 and volume, 2026-10-12). -26 LUFS is the reused bloom clip (narration-v1/gardenSuccess), the loudest of the kingdom narration; the 67 prototype clips range -43 to -26 LUFS (median -33) and are not changed.

phonemeReview.rule: A letter sound becomes a production clip only through scripts/letter-sounds.js approve (audition: "approved"), which copies the take to word-garden-v1/ and registers it in audio/reading.ts and records how it was approved: heard by a person, or on the owner's instruction without anyone listening. A take that says the letter name, adds a vowel ("suh", "muh"), or is the wrong vowel (short a must be the a in "cat", not "ah") is rejected.

kingdomVoiceV4.files: word-garden-phonemes-review/jo-v4.<letter>.take<N>.mp3 (three takes a letter), candidates only: none is approved or registered.
kingdomVoiceV4.approach: The spelled-out form the owner's ear approved in the side test (Mmmmmm. for m, Ssssss. for s, B-b-b. for b). Held sounds as a repeated letter (m n s z); short vowels as a held spelling then an ellipsis and the keyword (Aaaa… apple., Ehhh… egg., Ihhh… itch., Ahhh… octopus., Uhhh… up.) with only the sound before the pause kept; stops as a short repeated stop (B-b-b., K-k-k., D-d-d., G-g-g., P-p-p., T-t-t.) with the first burst kept, at most 0.28 s; h as Hhhh. with the breath kept, at most 0.7 s. No direction tags.
kingdomVoiceV4.cutting: Cut points from ffmpeg silencedetect (-45 dB, or -38 dB over 30 ms for stops), recorded per take (cut.startS, cut.endS, cut.what); 10 ms fade in, 30 ms fade out; one fixed gain to about -27 dB mean (volumedetect), the level of the recorded words, peak at most -1.5 dB; mp3 128 kbps mono 44.1 kHz.
kingdomVoiceV4.heard: Nobody has listened. rawTranscript is a blind faster-whisper small.en transcript of the uncut take; it is weak evidence for single sounds and says nothing about whether a vowel is right. To use one after listening: node scripts/letter-sounds.js approve <letter> assets/themes/magical-kingdom/audio/word-garden-phonemes-review/jo-v4.<letter>.take<N>.mp3 --heard (the takeN shorthand points at the older sound.<letter>.takeN files).
